Context: 2. Verification of Services

2. Procedure for verification.Main record will be Pay Bills/Pay Bills Register. Pay drawn during the year as entered in Pay Bills Register or Office copies of Pay Bills should agree with entries in Service Book. In some cases, leave salary drawn would have been noted in Pay Bills but leave entry omitted in Service Book.
